title: Engineering Fellowship
summary: Work on real AI systems alongside the lab — agentic pipelines, LLM applications, speech AI, and production MLOps. Designed for engineers who want serious project experience, not busy-work.
highlights: Open-source contributions with your name on them

title: Research Internship
summary: Contribute to active research in low-resource NLP or speech AI. Help with data collection, annotation pipelines, model evaluation, and writing. All work is published with proper attribution.
highlights: Access to lab datasets and compute resources

title: Volunteer Research Contributor
summary: Contribute to open-source tooling, dataset annotation, or benchmarking tasks on a flexible schedule. No minimum commitment — just genuine interest in doing useful work.

title: Industry Collaboration
summary: Partner with INFERENCE Lab on applied AI R&D. We work with organizations that need rigorous, reproducible engineering — not a vendor relationship, a research partnership.
highlights: Domain expertise in NLP, speech AI, LLM systems
